title: Autonomous Milestone Execution and End-to-End Engineering Orchestration

tasks.title: Deterministic controller and additive run persistence
acceptance_criteria: Persist intent before dispatch; unknown/conflicting state blocks; no second scheduler, GitHub adapter or process launcher.
Additive migration preserves existing data/audit; reconcile all 16 interruption cases without blindly replaying uncertain execution.
Reserve before parallel dispatch; resume retains counts; unknown cost stays unknown and unenforceable monetary caps block; exhaustion pauses durably.

tasks.title: Discovery, design-first generation and exact approval continuation
acceptance_criteria: Reject fixture roots, duplicate IDs, unknown dependencies and unverified completion; never infer numeric advancement.
Register immutable scope/revisions; correct repository ownership; requirements and validated design approvals precede implementation.
Reuse valid unchanged approvals; missing, rejected, expired, revoked or changed authority blocks; no direct approval inserts or self-approval.

tasks.title: Existing scheduler/Codex integration and budget reservations
acceptance_criteria: Existing task IDs/results/claims/leases remain authoritative; concurrent work obeys dependency and repository isolation.
Reserve before parallel dispatch; resume retains counts; unknown cost stays unknown and unenforceable monetary caps block; exhaustion pauses durably.

tasks.title: Independent quality, bounded remediation and AEO-5 integration
acceptance_criteria: AEO-4 QA/security/acceptance gates must pass; at most configured repairs (default three); design changes reapprove.
Remote writes default disabled; exact grants required; no duplicate PR/force push/protected writes/merge/deploy; formal completion separately verified.

tasks.title: Autonomous CLI, lifecycle reports and operational guides
acceptance_criteria: Default read-only dry-run; simulation isolated; local mode is not a grant; explicit run/milestone and JSON/Markdown reports.
Separate unit/integration/simulation/real Codex/live GitHub/unavailable/pending evidence and next permitted action.
